items.title: 67256_Paul L. Howard oral history interview
items.q: I don't know where Lloyd came from. But I'll try to find out for you and let you know.

ctx.x: There was a music store, if you remember, on Jefferson, and I met Lloyd Reese music studio.
Lloyd Reese. Now, you got the master.
Well, what do you think about Lloyd Reese, then? I thought he was the master. What do you think of him? Because he's taught a lot of us.
